hints.content: Therefore, we can set up equivalent proportions and solve for $k$.

$\dfrac{\red{k}}{\blue{7}} = \dfrac{\red{9}}{\blue{6}}$

 Note: As each corresponding $\dfrac{\red{\text{side}}}{\blue{\text{side}}}$ proportion is equivalent, you could use the other sides (i.e., $\dfrac{\red{k}}{\blue{7}} = \dfrac{\red{4.5}}{\blue{3}}$)

Reduce the proportion on the right hand side.

 $\dfrac{\red{k}}{\blue{7}} = \cancel{\dfrac{\red{9}}{\blue{6}}}{\green{\dfrac{3}{2}}}$

Multiply each side by $7$ and simplify.

 $\cancel{7} \times \dfrac{\red{k}}{\cancel{\blue{7}}} = \green{\dfrac{3}{2}} \times 7$
